calibration.cornerWarp: Monotonic radial mapping between native floor/rim convex hulls and existing arenaOutline / 2.56 m inward offset; source mesh retained.
calibration.turfHeight: Native turf vertices projected to existing floor / quarter-circle ramp surface; conforming source-triangle subdivisions added when edge interpolation error exceeds 0.02 m (up to six passes).
calibration.goalFloor: Original goal-floor triangles flattened to solver y=0.
calibration.trimHeight: Native floor/ramp trim vertices projected to solver surface plus 0.012 m.

goalFrameMouth.weight: (1 + cos(pi * abs(z-mouthPlane)/0.95))/2 inside the 0.95 m band, 0 beyond it
goalFrameMouth.method: Split native frame triangles at the mouth and both fade-boundary planes, scale Y about the original floor, then fit the measured left/right aperture profile at every native cross-section height. Bottom 0.1 m and top 0.12 m retain rounded corners. Cosine weights at vertices leave every original frame triangle outside the 0.95 m band unchanged.

limitations: The supplied model has no center circle, halfway line, penalty-box texture, nets, or boost-pad meshes. Native blue perimeter/ramp trim is preserved and team-colored; no extra pads or replacement goal primitives are included.

The native frame is fitted at the actual scoring-mouth plane to C.goalWidth/C.goalHeight using native triangle splits and a small deformation within 0.95 m of the mouth. Its flare farther behind, rounded corner silhouette and curved rear insert are retained. It is visual geometry, not an additional collider.
The back-plane anchor maps the farthest native goal-back vertex to existing goal depth, but the curved interior may lie in front of that rectangular solver plane.
No dome, exterior cage, or upper perimeter beam is included. Existing transparent wall/ceiling rendering can be retained independently if desired.
Floor calibration is exact at decoded vertices within quantization tolerance. Native triangles approximate curved collision surfaces between vertices; ray-probe errors report that interpolation gap.
